## File: facebookresearch_torchbeast/third_party/grpc/src/python/grpcio_health_checking/grpc_health/v1/health.py

Prompts

```
['create a HealthServicer instance to handle gRPC health check RPCs for service statuses', 'check the health status of a named gRPC service using the HealthServicer Check method', 'watch for health status changes on a gRPC service using the HealthServicer Watch method', 'set the health status of a named service to SERVING or NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer set', 'enter graceful shutdown mode that sets all services to NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer']
```

Usage

```
{'create_health_servicer': 'create a HealthServicer instance to handle gRPC health check RPCs for service statuses', 'check_service_status': 'check the health status of a named gRPC service using the HealthServicer Check method', 'watch_service_health': 'watch for health status changes on a gRPC service using the HealthServicer Watch method', 'set_service_status': 'set the health status of a named service to SERVING or NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer set', 'enter_graceful_shutdown': 'enter graceful shutdown mode that sets all services to NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer'}
```
